    AI Overview
    Cori Close
     is the Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach, a position she has held since April 2011. She has led the Bruins to significant success, including their first-ever NCAA Final Four appearance in 2025, and was named the 2025 National Coach of the Year (AP, Naismith, USBWA, WBCA). 
    Key Details About Cori Close: 
    • Record: As of April 2026, she has over 300 wins at UCLA.
    • Achievements: Led UCLA to the 2025 Big Ten Tournament Championship and the 2025 Final Four.
    • Background: Previously served as associate head coach at Florida State and played at UC Santa Barbara
      .
    • Focus: Known for player development, defensive intensity, and navigating the modern NIL landscape in college sports. 
    The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Associate Head Coach Tony Newnan and Assistant Coaches Tasha Brown, Soh Matsuura, James Clark, and Michaela Onyenwere.

    Where did Cori Close coach before UCLA?
    Florida State University
    Close, who served on the Bruin coaching staff in 1994 and 1995, returned to Westwood after spending seven seasons as associate head coach at Florida State University. Considered one of the top offensive minds in the game, Close helped guide the Seminoles into a nationally-recognized program in her time.
